4. test_toWire_nonNullEmptyList: sections array length 4, section1 list empty. Verify header called once, no record calls.

5. test_toWire_emptySectionsArray: set sections field to new List[0]; header called once, no loops.

6. test_toWire_headerBeforeRecordsOrder: Use InOrder verification to ensure header called before record.

7. test_toWire_singleCompressionInstanceReused: capture Compression argument from each record's toWire; verify same instance.

8. test_toWire_exceptionPropagationFromRecord: mock Record to throw IOException; expect exception.

9. test_toWire_nullSectionsArray: set sections to null; expect NullPointerException.

10. test_toWire_nullHeader: set header to null; expect NullPointerException.

11. test_toWire_listContainsNullRecord: sections[0] list with null element; expect NullPointerException.

12. test_toWire_nullOutParameter: call message.toWire(null); expect NullPointerException.

13. test_toWire_headerThrowsIOException: mock header to throw IOException; expect IOException.

14. test_toWire_headerThrowsRuntimeException: mock header to throw RuntimeException; expect RuntimeException.

15. test_toWire_recordThrowsRuntimeException: mock record to throw RuntimeException; expect RuntimeException.

16. test_toWire_sectionListIteratorThrowsRuntimeException: custom List that throws on iterator().next(). We'll create a List implementation that returns iterator that throws.

Actually you can configure mock to throw a checked exception only if the method signature declares it. If header.toWire declares IOException, then we can configure. We'll assume it does.

We'll need to create a dummy DNSOutput mock; but DNSOutput is a concrete class with methods; we can just mock it.

We also need to capture Compression argument; Compression class is not public? It's package-private maybe. We'll need to refer to it via its full name: org.xbill.DNS.Compression. We'll capture as Object.

Implementation details: For verification of no Record.toWire calls, we can verifyZeroInteractions(recordMock) or verify(recordMock, never()).toWire(...).

But Record.toWire signature: rec.toWire(out, i, c); So we need to match any DNSOutput, any int, any Compression.
